string-array.name: break_tips_short
string-array.item: 💧 Drink a glass of water.
👀 20-20-20 rule: look at something far away for 20 seconds.
🙆 Stretch your neck: tilt your head to each side for 10 seconds.
🌬️ 4-7-8 breathing: inhale 4 seconds, hold 7, exhale 8. Three times.
🚶 Stand up and walk a little, even around the room.
✋ Open and close your hands ten times and roll your wrists.
🪟 Open the window or find some natural light.
🧘 Shoulders up, hold 3 seconds, let them drop. Five times.

string-array.name: break_tips_long
string-array.item: 🍎 Have a light snack and some water. No screens for a while.
🚶 Take a 10-minute walk: your brain sorts out what you learned.
🧘 Stretch your back: arms up, then reach for your toes gently.
😌 Close your eyes and breathe slowly. A real rest counts too.
